departments.billing: Invoices, charged amounts, refunds, payment methods, subscription billing or cancellation.
departments.technical: Application failures, outages, or integration bugs, excluding issues limited to login or account access.
departments.account: Login, password or MFA recovery, account access, profile changes, or account lifecycle requests unrelated to billing.
departments.other: No clear primary request, equally primary requests for different teams, or none of the teams fit.
